components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances a task through an explicit approval or apply action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #516bd6; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #516bd6; border-radius: 9px; padding: .68rem .92rem; font: 650 15px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #405ac7; border-color: #405ac7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a9b9f8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Performs setup or non-primary task actions without competing with approval.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #202938; border: 1px solid #d4dbe7; border-radius: 9px; padding: .68rem .92rem; font: 650 15px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8faff; border-color: #b5c1d4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a9b9f8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Captures a project path or one bounded task instruction.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #202938; border: 1px solid #d4dbe7; border-radius: 9px; padding: .72rem .8rem; font: 400 15px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a9b9f8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Makes review, running, success, and failure legible at a glance.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; background: #fff7df; color: #9a6500; border-radius: 999px; padding: .27rem .58rem; font: 750 12px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Keeps task state, next action, output, and exact change review in one readable record.
components.html:
Review the proposed file changes

Inspect the exact before-and-after files.
components.css: .ds-task-card { background: #fff; color: #202938; border: 1px solid #e3e7ef; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem; } .ds-task-card p { color: #6b7485; margin: .4rem 0 0; }

components.name: Application Navigation
components.description: Keeps original Chat and additive Tasks one click apart.
components.html: ChatTasks
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #e5e8ee; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffffee; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px #1a223014; } .ds-nav a { color: #697386; border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 10px; text-decoration: none; font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #f2f4f8; color: #202938; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d8ff5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: #eef2ff; color: #405ac7; }

narrative.overview:
The Command Center treats every file change as a visible, reviewable record. The interface is restrained and bright so state, action, and exact content carry the attention; indigo marks the next approved action, while status colors distinguish review, success, and failure without turning the workspace into a game.

The system uses compact system typography, cool neutral surfaces, thin structural borders, and code-like panes for before-and-after content. It belongs beside DSH Chat rather than replacing it, so the navigation is familiar and the task route remains a calm utility.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral canvas with one indigo action accent.
Exact content shown in bounded scrollable panes.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Use indigo for the action that moves the task forward; keep supporting controls neutral.

dos: Do keep the current task action visible without requiring a hidden menu.
Do show exact file content in readable, scrollable monospace panes.
Do keep keyboard focus rings visible and controls native.
donts: Don't turn Tasks into a second chat shell or executor console.
Don't imply that execution changed the original before Apply succeeds.
Don't hide failure and interruption states behind a generic completion label.
